note: REFERENCE_SEAT uses the stone solid as a CUTTING TOOL against production metal. Never a fuse: the stone contributes no material and is discarded when the cut returns, so LAW-006 holds unchanged. It is relief, NOT a cut seat with a bearing shoulder, and no claim is made that a stone would sit correctly in it. Off by default, so every pre-Sprint-23 design keeps its geometry.

modes.description: No relief, and the default. Stone and metal overlap exactly as they did before Sprint 23.

The stone solid is used as a CUTTING TOOL against production metal, so metal no longer occupies the stone's volume. Never a fuse, so LAW-006 holds. REFERENCE relief only: it is not a cut seat with a bearing shoulder and no claim is made that a stone would sit correctly in it.
